candidate_search_budget: Explicit revision after original budget closed with no artifact-eligible candidate: ONE new RGB run, same primary seed/backbone/data/optimizer/crop policy/loss weights/20 epochs, exactly three candidates at epochs 5,10,20. Only L1 is computed before output clipping; SSIM and inference stay bounded. Do not merge candidate budgets or rewrite original decisions. Future controlled depth run must match the chosen revised protocol.
selection_policy: Native-size selection 40 only after diagnostic implementation checks; artifact screen first; maximize mean PSNR, ties within 0.01 dB use higher mean SSIM then earlier step. Record all candidates. No test/challenging access.
review_rubric: Zero major artifacts; at most 10 percent minor. Major: introduced/worsened false structure, lost recognizable content, strong halos or severe noise. Minor: other visible correction defects. Independent reviewer records remain required by PRD.
revision_basis: Diagnostic-only four-check investigation and real gradient probe on 851_img_: saturated predictions with interior references have zero direct bounded-L1 gradient. Pre-clamp L1 restores that gradient. Quality improvement is unproven.
changed_from_v1: L1 uses unclamped residual prediction instead of clipped RGB.
diagnostic_acceptance_before_selection: First evaluate diagnostic 40 and inspect clipping/colour/detail. Selection remains for checkpoint choice, not architecture/loss debugging. Any further change requires another documented protocol and output paths.
